name: Pringles Sour Cream & Onion Potato Crisps (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Heavily dusted with concentrated dehydrated onion powder, garlic powder, sour cream solids, and MSG. The intense fructan content provokes rapid fermentation and severe gas pain.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Pringles Original (Plain Salt) instead, which is completely free of onion and garlic powders.
